set.body:
Outcome

Make voxel, surface, atlas, ROI, and searchlight support ordinary constructors in the unified mvpa vocabulary.

Acceptance

- Builders return MeasurementFrame directly and consume exact locus identities.
- Rendition scatters AnalysisResult values without FeatureSetPlan or SpatialFeaturePlan mirrors.
- Geometry algorithms remain in their rightful image, surface, atlas, or locus owners.
- The mvpa-spatial artifact and adapter vocabulary are deleted.
set.title: P6.3: absorb mvpa-spatial as direct frame builders and typed rendition
